examples.arabic: قلت له ده سعر حلو واشتريت اتنين كيلو
examples.english: I told him this is a good price and bought two kilos.
examples.transliteration: olt loh da sear helw wa eshtaret etnen kilo

examples.arabic: انا فاصلت مع البياع في السعر
examples.english: I bargained with the seller on the price.
examples.transliteration: ana faselt maa el bayaa fe el seaar

examples.arabic: فاصلنا في السعر لحد ما وصلنا لاتفاق كويس
examples.english: We bargained over the price until we reached a good deal.
examples.transliteration: fasilna fi el sear lihad ma wisilna li ittifaaq kwayyis

examples.arabic: منى شايلة شنطتها الكبيرة وبتبص في كتب سوق العتبة، والسعر ده غالي خالص عليها.
examples.english: Mona, carrying her big bag, was looking at the books in Ataba market, and this price was too expensive for her.
examples.transliteration: Mona shayla shantetha el-kebira we betbos fi kotob Souq El Ataba, wel se'r da ghali khales 3aleha.
examples.storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

examples.arabic: منى شايفة قماش كتير في العتبة بس البياع قال سعر غالي خالص.
examples.english: Mona sees a lot of fabric in El-Ataba, but the vendor quoted a very expensive price.
examples.transliteration: Mona shayfa oumash keteir fi el-Ataba bas el-bayya3 aal se3r ghaly khales.

examples.arabic: منى كان معاها خمسين جنيه بس في شنطتها؛ يعني ده سعر كويس، بس هي كانت قلقانة.
examples.english: Mona only had fifty pounds in her bag; meaning, this was a good price, but she was worried.
examples.transliteration: Mona kan ma'aha khamseen geneh bas fi shantetha; ya'ni dah se'r kwayyes, bas heya kanet 'alqana.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street
